m.t: Students will be able to understand clear, standard speech on appearances and personalities.
Students will be able to talk about other people’s appearances and personalities.
Students will be able to report on the appearances and personalities of other people.
Students will be able to understand a simple text about appearances, personalities, and comparisons, including explanations and reasons.
Students will be able to write simple texts comparing people.

haftalar.kn: Describing characters/people (Making simple inquiries) —What does your best friend look like? —S/he is beautiful/handsome, with curly hair and green eyes. —What is s/he like? —S/he is slimmer than me and s/he has short and dark hair. —My cousin is more outgoing than me; s/he has a lot of friends.
